card.description: A visible manifestation of respiration within the cold, hostile atmospheres of the Ancient-tech world. It appears as dense, volumetric vapor or crystalline mist, marking the biological presence of the protagonist against the sterile, metallic, or freezing environments. It serves as a dynamic visual element, catching rim lighting and emphasizing the temperature gradient between the warm organic interior and the harsh exterior void.
visual_anatomy: **Body/Form:** Volumetric cloud of condensing moisture, varying from thin wisps to dense, opaque plumes depending on exertion and ambient temperature. Irregular, organic shapes contrasting with rigid tech geometry.
**Texture/Material:** Soft, diffuse aerosol, swiftly dissipating. In freezing voids (Merkabah Pod), it may show micro-crystallization or sublimation traits, appearing sharper and more glittering.
**Lighting Interaction:** Highly reactive to scene lighting; catches red rim lights (Observation Deck), harsh white floodlights, or dark blue void glow. Translucent but obscuring.
**Key Features:** Originates from the mouth/nose area of the subject (Henoch), expanding outward and upward, dissolving into the environment.
evolution: Phase 1 (Default): Standard atmospheric condensation indicating cold or exertion. A grounding element of realism in a surreal setting.
card.prompt_block: cinematic close-up detail, visible breath exhaling from mouth, dense white vapor cloud condensing in cold air, volumetric steam effect, sharp focus on the mist texture against a dark blurred industrial background, atmospheric lighting catching the vapor particles, hyper-realistic, 8k, tactile moisture
